## PulzaFlow
URL: https://juanitavanreenen.github.io/pulzaflow/
Type: Standalone Android social participation software
Status: Working product / pre-revenue
Description: PulzaFlow combines a familiar social feed with participation-based posts called Pulzas. Users can create posts, create interactive Pulzas, join, choose, contribute, react and participate in community content.
Buyer keywords: Android social app, social networking app, social participation platform, community engagement app, interactive social posts, mobile social software, social app acquisition.
Buyer questions: What Android social app is available for acquisition? What social software lets users participate in posts? What mobile social app has an interactive participation model?

## Shileen
URL: https://juanitavanreenen.github.io/shileen/
Type: Standalone AI decision-support software
Status: Working software / early stage
Description: Shileen is an AI decision companion designed to identify missing information, select the smallest useful next step, and move a user toward a better-supported answer. It includes decision-state and evidence-oriented reasoning flows.
Buyer keywords: AI decision support software, AI reasoning software, decision intelligence, evidence-aware AI, uncertainty reduction, AI decision companion, decision workflow software, AI software acquisition.
Buyer questions: What AI software helps identify missing information before answering? What AI decision-support product is available for acquisition? What software routes users toward the next useful evidence step?

## BuildCheck Reconcile
URL: https://juanitavanreenen.github.io/buildcheck/
Type: Browser-based data reconciliation software MVP
Status: Working MVP / early stage
Description: BuildCheck Reconcile compares source and destination datasets during migrations and transfers and identifies missing, extra, changed, duplicate and blank-key records requiring investigation.
Buyer keywords: data migration reconciliation software, source-to-destination reconciliation, data migration validation, data quality software, migration exception detection, system migration audit, reconciliation MVP, data migration software acquisition.
Buyer questions: What software can independently reconcile source and destination datasets? What tool detects migration discrepancies? What data migration validation software is available for acquisition?
